scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Business and Newsroom indexes, the 2026 Hobbies Trend Report, Pinterest Predicts 2026, the 2026 Palette and public Pinterest design-inspiration results were checked on 22 October 2026. The newest durable signals remain intention-led planning, tactile and screen-light hobbies, collections as identity, and colour-led discovery. Public Pins supplied metadata but no sufficiently new visual pattern to justify a command.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.25.0 with 720 commands was read before evaluation. /intent-to-action covers the planning-to-purchase journey; /taste-discovery-system and /trend-to-brand translate aesthetic collections into brand systems; /analog-keepsake and /tactile-surreal cover offline craft and tactile materiality; /emotional-palette covers colour-led discovery. No materially new, non-duplicate command was warranted. The userscript and metadata remained byte-identical, and all 18 regression checks passed.
trends: Pinterest continues to frame discovery around intentions and future actions rather than passive attention
The 2026 Hobbies report highlights screen-light, hands-on practices, tactile crafts, miniatures, upcycling and analog rituals
Curated collections increasingly operate as expressions of identity and taste, not just storage
Pinterest Predicts 2026 still favours tactile, nostalgic, maximal and deliberately imperfect visual worlds
The 2026 Palette continues to support monochrome systems, seasonal colour roles and colour-led discovery
skipped: No hobby-system command because /analog-keepsake, /tactile-surreal, /lifestyle and /trend-to-brand already convert offline craft and tactile signals into usable creative direction
No Curated Clutter or collection-as-identity command because /taste-discovery-system, /moodboard, /brandstyle and /layout already cover curation, hierarchy and translation into coherent brand assets
No Kitchen Witch, Casual Crafter or Tiny Tactiles aliases because they are topical motifs rather than reusable production capabilities
No individual Pinterest Predicts or Palette aliases because existing trend, palette and art-direction commands already support controlled adaptation without locking the catalogue to seasonal labels
No visual command was derived from public Pinterest results whose accessible metadata repeated established typography, paper-texture and 2026 graphic-design themes
